index: Consumer Price Index, all items, January 2010 = 100, Department of Statistics, St Kitts and Nevis (2025 as the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank publishes it)
note: Monthly: each year's mean is of its twelve months. 2021's are the Department of Statistics' own (their mean, 105.900833, is its 2021 annual average, 105.9). 2025's are the Department's index as the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank's table carries it, the Department publishing no 2025 table yet; the Bank's 2021 months are the Department's, and its 2024 months' mean (113.860833) is the Department's 2024 annual average (113.86), so the two are one series.
